topics.summary: A reporting function replaces a rejected parse with zero and then emits a normal reading. The program no longer crashes, but the customer cannot distinguish malformed input from a genuine zero measurement. The defect is semantic information loss. The correction is not a different default number; it is preserving absence or a structured error until the policy-owning layer decides what to do.
